work.englishTitle: Secret B + MAXQ Compilation Vol. 02: Yoon Na-gyeom
work.summary: Distinct MAXQ digital photobook compilation featuring Korean model and influencer Yoon Na-gyeom (윤나겸). RIDI identifies this separately titled Vol. 02 as a 65-page PDF published 2022-06-02 and describes it as combining selected and unreleased cuts from Secret B and MAXQ. It is a separate retail work from Secret B Vol. 9; image-level overlap has not been checked. No cover image or paid PDF was copied because reuse permission is unconfirmed.

edition.contentSummary: RIDI lists this as a 65-page PDF e-book published 2022-06-02. Its product description identifies an online photobook compilation of selected and unreleased Secret B and MAXQ images. No ISBN is listed. No full PDF or cover is copied or mirrored; exact-image overlap with Secret B Vol. 9 remains unchecked.
